title: Placement MCQ prompt / item quality (PY4E scope)

criteria.name: Objective fit
criteria.description: Each question clearly tests its rubric concept for this level; stem and correct answer align with that skill, not unrelated trivia.

criteria.name: Understanding vs trivia
criteria.description: Questions reward conceptual understanding (predict output, choose behavior, fix logic) rather than memorizing obscure facts.

criteria.name: Clarity and fairness
criteria.description: Stem is unambiguous at this level; distractors are plausible but not misleading due to sloppy wording.

criteria.name: PY4E / foundations scope
criteria.description: Content fits Python for Everybody-style foundations; no off-scope advanced frameworks unless appropriate for the placement level.

criteria.name: Set coherence
criteria.description: The five questions feel like a coherent block for one tier: difficulty is consistent and slots are not repetitive.
